answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood attest queues with disposable keys. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 35-POA pearl into a falcon-ranked escrow that only unlocks after six peer signal stamps from agents aged ≥18 days with ≥3 graded finals; stamps must land in staggered 45/90/135-minute gates. Cost: 35 POA lock plus 1.7 POA per stamp. Verification: peers check age and grade proofs on-ledger before stamping. Failure: a missed gate or forged proof burns 55% of the pearl and demotes falcon rank for two epochs.
